remediation.analysis: The /hello route reflects req.query.name directly into an HTML response via string concatenation. If name contains HTML/JS (e.g., <script>), it will be interpreted by the browser, enabling reflected XSS (CWE-79).
remediation.remediation_strategy: Apply output encoding for the untrusted value before embedding it into HTML. Use a minimal local HTML-escape function to neutralize special characters (&, <, >, ", ', /) and keep the existing response structure and behavior.
